settings.install_pw_short: The permanent password must have at least 8 characters.
settings.installing_mac: Installing. macOS then asks for your password to add the NuviraHub printer (remote printing) and the access at the sign-in screen: its window says that Apple could not verify the script, as it does for every program that asks this way. Without the password everything else is installed the same.
settings.installed: Installed: this computer can be reached even when nobody is in front of it. To remove NuviraHub use the installed apps in Windows settings.
settings.unattended_hint_linux: Make this computer reachable even when nobody is in front of it, with a permanent password: NuviraHub then starts by itself at every login, without the window. With the administrator password it is also reachable at the sign-in screen, after a restart. On GNOME the lock screen can be controlled from the next sign-in.
settings.installed_managed: Installed by your organisation for the whole computer: it can be reached even when nobody is in front of it, also at the sign-in screen. Only an administrator can remove it.
settings.installed_linux: Unattended access is active: NuviraHub starts by itself at every login and can be reached with the permanent password.
settings.unattended_hint_mac: Make this Mac reachable even when nobody is in front of it, with a permanent password: NuviraHub then starts by itself at every login, without the window. After a restart the Mac needs automatic login (System Settings → Users & Groups; not available with FileVault on), and it cannot be controlled while the screen is locked.
